accepted_answers.name: pytest (fixtures + monkeypatch/tmp_path)
accepted_answers.why: De-facto test standard: fixture injection, tmp_path/monkeypatch/capsys helpers, huge plugin ecosystem.

accepted_answers.name: unittest.mock (Python standard library)
accepted_answers.why: Accepted stdlib mocking companion: Mock/patch/assert_called_with, usable inside pytest too.

notes: Strong consensus. A hand-written fixture/mocking mini-framework duplicates pytest features (scopes, autouse, parametrization) badly.
problem: Building test fixtures and mocks in Python with a hand-written mini-framework.
